version.approval_notes: The attached source archive is this version's complete source: the repository tree at the release commit, its submodules and the pinned zip.js, gifenc and lamejs sources (SOURCE_REVISIONS.json records them). docs/source-build.md in it says how to rebuild the WebAssembly dictionary engine, extension/vendor/hoshidicts*.{mjs,wasm}, with Emscripten and CMake from wasm/ and third_party/hoshidicts, and where extension/vendor/zip.js, gifenc.js and lamejs.js come from. The uploaded package is the release's Firefox ZIP, which scripts/package-store.py writes from that same commit; docs/firefox.md describes how it differs from the Chrome build.
